description: Inspects EIP-712 typed data before signing: kind (EIP-2612 or DAI permit, Permit2 allowance or transfer, EIP-3009 transfer authorization as used by x402, Seaport order, Safe transaction, generic), digest, chain id with mismatch check, verifying contract with token symbol and decimals, spender or recipient, raw and formatted amount, unlimited flag, deadline window in ISO time, risk level, flags with reasons, one-line summary. Sources: JSON-RPC via PublicNode, Sourcify. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

expected_chain.description: Chain the signature should be for (id such as 8453 or eip155:8453, or a supported name); a different domain chainId is flagged.

expected_spender.description: Address expected as spender or recipient (the payTo for an x402 payment); a different address is flagged.

typed.description: EIP-712 typed data as JSON (URL-encoded in the query) or base64 of it, max 16 KB; also accepts eth_signTypedData_v4 params [address, typedData].

name: chain_sign_inspect
title: EIP-712 signature request inspector (permits, x402)
